name: mi300x-single-gpu-serving-matrix
description: Shared client workload contract for llama.cpp, vLLM and SGLang on one AMD MI300X.
comparison_contract: Keep model family, revision, tokenizer and weight format explicit.
Keep prompt targets, output limit, temperature and request count unchanged.
Record server flags separately; do not silently compare different context or slot limits.
Treat GGUF-vs-BF16/FP8 results as deployment-route comparisons, not pure framework wins.
